title: Ethiopian Airlines says Eritrea has frozen ticket sale revenues
desc: Ethiopian Airlines said it is still unable to access money earned from ticket sales in Eritrea, with Chief Executive Mesfin Tasew saying a substantial amount of the carrier’s revenue remains frozen because of the political dispute between the two countries. Mesfin said the funds have remained inaccessible as relations between Ethiopia and Eritrea have deteriorated, preventing the airline from repatriating revenues generated from its operations in Eritrea. This is not the first time the airline chief has raised the issue, having previously highlighted the financial challenges caused by blocked funds and the broader deterioration in bilateral relations. title: CFPs: Conduct a National Attitudinal Survey (Namibia)
desc: Deadline: 07-Aug-2026 The Other Foundation is seeking experienced research teams to conduct a comprehensive national survey on public attitudes towards homosexuality and gender diversity in Namibia. The consultancy requires expertise in large-scale social surveys, ethical research, statistical analysis, and collaboration with civil society, with successful applicants responsible for survey design, implementation, data analysis, and reporting.
